limitations: Fixed growth sensitivities and initial biomass; fitted cases are not weighted probabilities.
Growth and observation errors are declared toy lognormal perturbations.
No assessment is refitted during these management trials.
Empirical trial fractions are conditional illustrations, not validated risk estimates.
Annual growth is capped at one to retain the simple Euler update within its stable range.

buffered.description: Apply an index step and 80% catch buffer; limit annual advice changes to 15%.
buffered.name: Buffered rule

constant.description: Keep catch at its recent mean.
constant.name: Constant catch

index.description: Scale catch by the three-year mean observed index.
index.name: Index rule

result.scope: Illustrative seeded closed-loop Schaefer trials; no management advice.

log: Report the tested procedures, their trade-offs and the limits of the example.
